comments: 3af2a9ac: This program is used for completing records in the Deficiency Tracking system.
abacbd8a: Initialize variables and set the environment for completion.
bf0924b9: If divisional tracking is enabled, prompt the user to select a division.
92071fe1: If no division has been selected, use the default division from the Medical Center Division file.
1a26eaa8: Warn the user if the necessary parameters are not set up in the division file for delinquency tracking.
441f5d6c: Set the completion status to either 'REVIEWED' or 'SIGNED NO REVIEW' based on the division settings.
83b4cd90: Prompt the user to select a completed patient record for the specified division and completion status.
e3ff909c: Display the selected patient record.
ab81369c: Check for user exit or timeout and return to the main menu if detected.
c03eb186: Loop back to allow the user to select another patient record.
bd14316a: Clear variables and exit routine.
0b0bc50c: Clean up variables specific to this program and quit.
